senses.zh_definition: 与印地语、乌尔都语中表示“月光”的词相对应的拉丁字母转写形式；尚未核实为标准马来语词。
senses.en_definition: A Latin-script rendering of a Hindi–Urdu word meaning moonlight; not verified here as a standard Malay word.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk transliterasi Rumi bagi kata bahasa Hindi–Urdu yang bermaksud cahaya bulan.
senses.nuances: 可核实的是相关外语词义；输入没有原文字形或原句，不能据此排除姓名、标题等其他所指。印地语相关形式为 चाँदनी。此处马来语释义为编辑说明，并非 DBP 官方释义。以下搭配是马来语释义及转写讨论示例，不宣称 chandni 本身具有高频马来语搭配。排名来自输入，例句为原创。[Hindwi 词典](https://www.hindwi.org/hindi-dictionary/meaning-of-chaandnii)、[Rekhta 词典](https://rekhtadictionary.com/meaning-of-chaandnii?lang=hi)。

dual_scenarios.context: 职场汇报 / 翻译说明
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam nota terjemahan ini, perkataan Hindi yang ditransliterasikan sebagai 'chandni' diberikan padanan bahasa Melayu 'cahaya bulan'.
dual_scenarios.zh: 本翻译说明将转写为 chandni 的印地语词译为马来语 cahaya bulan，即“月光”。
dual_scenarios.en: In this translation note, the Hindi word transliterated as 'chandni' is given the Malay equivalent 'cahaya bulan', meaning 'moonlight'.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友讨论印地语词义
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: 'Chandni' tu maksudnya cahaya bulan ke? Aku baru jumpa perkataan ni.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah 'chandni' itu bermaksud cahaya bulan? Saya baru menemukan perkataan ini.
dual_scenarios.zh: chandni 是月光的意思吗？我刚看到这个词。
dual_scenarios.en: Does 'chandni' mean moonlight? I've just come across the word.

etymology.historical_story: The spelling chandni represents a South Asian word rather than a demonstrated Malay formation. Hindi dictionaries record चाँदनी with the meaning moonlight, and Urdu lexicography records a corresponding word. Roman spelling alone does not identify the intended occurrence: a source passage is needed to distinguish ordinary vocabulary from a name or title. No Malay borrowing history is established here. [Hindwi](https://www.hindwi.org/hindi-dictionary/meaning-of-chaandnii), [Rekhta](https://rekhtadictionary.com/meaning-of-chaandnii?lang=hi).
